model_setup_scope: Measured fitting-model construction; table setup is part of common initialization. FFT injection prepares FFT code before fitting, so additional FFT setup is not claimed cold.

vbm_adapter.abi_check: 5.x header, binary and table verified against same distribution RECORD
vbm_adapter.build_cache: once per process; fresh temporary build

common_initialization: Bundled-table model construction, joint MAP and covariance; measured cost charged to every method
ess_estimator: emcee integrated_time(c=5), physical parameter ACFs averaged over series; ESS=N/tau
scope: Nine event, parallax, limb-darkening and flux parameters on identical seed-43 FFT-injected Roman-like observations. No GP is evaluated. Primary comparison: table/NUTS, FFTLog/NUTS, VBM/emcee; table/emcee controls for the sampler. Total time includes common table-model setup and MAP, additional backend setup, JIT, warmup and production; excludes data generation, IO, plots, diagnostics and numerical validation. Two NUTS chains or two independent emcee ensembles; all runs require minimum ESS>=target and convergence checks. VBM uses the recorded interface, Tol=RelTol=1e-3 and minannuli=2. Numerical lens errors differ, and the VBM comparison also changes sampler. Single seed; rates are not universal speedups.

fft.convention: fft minus table on table/NUTS posterior states

VBM.convention: VBM minus table on table/NUTS posterior states

table.scope: All epochs at the injected physical parameters; fit model minus fixed FFT injection

fft.scope: All epochs at the injected physical parameters; fit model minus fixed FFT injection

reference_magnification.scope: Independent lens-centered source integration, sampled epochs spanning the season, peak and contact; no full-data likelihood inferred from this subset

table.scope: Warm full posterior callbacks on evenly spaced NUTS posterior states. Batch sizes include both stretch-move halves. Input preparation and JIT excluded from warm medians; every result synchronized. No gradient for VBM.

fft.scope: Warm full posterior callbacks on evenly spaced NUTS posterior states. Batch sizes include both stretch-move halves. Input preparation and JIT excluded from warm medians; every result synchronized. No gradient for VBM.

figure_regeneration.scope: Axis label spacing only; regenerated from unchanged saved posterior samples. Timing and measurement source hashes are unchanged.
